children.value: > Fact From Story: Manchester United, one of the grandest and richest names in this competition, have again gone out of the Champions League at the group stage.
> > Fact From Story: It is the third time it has happened since Sir Alex Ferguson, meaning it’s their most common round of exit in that period.
> > > Fact From Story: The performance this season was so bad that they find themselves out of Europe altogether as the bottom team in the group | Fact From Story
> > > Fact From Story: The second place they aimed for has instead gone to Copenhagen, a club with a fraction of United’s budget. | Fact From Story
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: A team can perform badly and exit a competition early if they are not strong enough. | Commonsense Knowledge
> > Fact From Story: The performance this season was so bad that they find themselves out of Europe altogether as the bottom team in the group
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A team can perform badly and exit a competition early if they are not strong enough.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Teams that are out of the Champions League group stage are out of Europe.
